In practice you do not have to: after each turn the plugi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n distils what is worth keeping into facts, summaries and keywords in the background."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Retrieval"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Most memory plugins retrieve through one channel: vector similarity, or full-text match. dsh-memgas "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"runs four in parallel and fuses them by rank:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Channel | What it is | Good at | Can be disabled |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Lexical | SQLite FTS5, identifiers kept intact | Paths, package names, error codes, exact wording "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"| No |
| Dense | Vector similarity | The same question asked differently | No |
| Granularity | Sess"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ion / turn / summary / keyword retrieved separately, weighted by an entropy router | Deciding whethe"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"r a whole session or one turn is the right unit | Yes |
| Graph | Personalized PageRank over the ass"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ociation graph, seeded by the baseline hits | Multi-hop links across sessions | Yes |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Fusion is Reciprocal Rank Fusion: rank-based, never score-based. Channel scores are not comparable ("},{"id":"p19s2","text":"BM25 against cosine against PageRank mass), so a channel whose scores are miscalibrated can still on"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ly contribute through its ordering."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Baseline floor.** At least half the final slots are reserved for the lexical and dense channels. T"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"he enhancement channels can add and reorder, never evict. The worst case equals plain retrieval."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Automatic degradation.** Too few memories and only the baseline runs. An entropy router with no si"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"gnal falls back to uniform weights. A graph too sparse to mean anything is skipped; a hub node gets "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"its edges trimmed rather than the whole channel switched off. A channel that throws or overruns its "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"budget is dropped and the rest still fuse. The whole path has a latency budget. A failed retrieval n"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ever affects the turn in progress."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`/memory diag <query>` prints every channel's raw results and the fusion that produced the final ran"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"king, so each memory can be traced to the channel, rank and score that surfaced it."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Memory evolves"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Memory is not a write-only log. Six background processes keep it in order, all on a queue, none on t"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"he critical path of a turn:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Associate** — a new memory is clustered against the similarity distribution of existing ones and"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" linked to those that genuinely relate
- **Reconcile** — duplicates merge, superseded facts get a ve"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"rsion chain, contradictions are kept as both sides with the conflict recorded
- **Reinforce** — memo"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ries that were retrieved and actually used gain weight; memories repeatedly retrieved together becom"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"e linked
- **Decay** — untouched memories are archived (archived, never deleted, always restorable)
"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"- **Abstract** — once a cluster grows large enough it is summarized into a higher-level convention, "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"sources left intact
- **Re-associate** — the graph is refreshed as the store grows so it reflects th"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"e current distribution"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"A failure in any one process affects neither the others nor the conversation."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Tools and commands"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Three tools for the model: `memory_search`, `memory_save`, `memory_status`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`/memory` for you:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Override by id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Every field is optional:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The full field list is in the design document (Chinese)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Privacy and storage"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The store is a local SQLite file per project scope under `$DSH_HOME/memgas/`, so a single project's "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"memories can be exported or deleted on their own. Scope is derived from the normalized git remote, s"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"o a repository cloned on another machine maps to the same memories."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Nothing leaves your machine.** Summarization and maintenance reuse the model you already configure"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"d in dsh: no extra API key, no third-party service. Credential-shaped content is stripped before any"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"a API key, no third-party service. Credential-shaped content is stripped before anything is written."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **The local embedding model has not been verified against real weights.** The ONNX path was tested"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" with an injected fake runtime; mean pooling and dimension handling have not run against an actual m"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"odel. It is off by default.
- **`memgas-mcp` has not been connected to a real MCP client**, only its"},{"id":"p39s4","text":" JSON-RPC layer is verified.
- **In one-shot mode, distillation lags by one session.** `dsh --profil"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"e headless` exits before the extraction model answers. - **Multiple workspaces.** Scope is resolved per session from its working di"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"rectory, but this path has not been exercised in a multi-workspace `dsh web` setup.
